models_alias_empty: Leave it empty to show the provider's own id, %1$s.
models_alias_hint: Tap a model to give it a display name. Pickers show that name.
models_auxiliary_hint: Models for the hub's side jobs, such as naming chats and summarising. A role left alone uses the default profile's.
models_clear_key_body: The stored key is wiped. The provider stops answering until a new key is saved.
models_custom_hint: Any OpenAI-compatible server: a proxy, a local model, a speech server.
models_defaults_hint: Every agent of this profile uses this model unless it is set to another.
models_fallbacks_need_default: Choose a chat model first; the fallbacks are tried after it.
models_hint_stt: The microphone and voice mode send what you say to this provider.
models_hint_tts: Reading replies aloud and voice mode speak through this provider.
models_images_hint_full: The model this profile draws and edits images with. It comes from your chat providers; a profile that chooses none uses the default profile's.
models_images_none_hint: None of your chat providers offers an image model. Add or refresh one that has one, such as OpenAI with gpt-image or a signed-in ChatGPT subscription.
models_images_used_by: Hermes's image tool and the image skills use this model with its provider's key.
models_key_hint: Paste the key. Every provider accepts one.
models_key_on_file: This provider's account already has a key saved here; it is used unless you type another.
models_key_replace_hint: A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
models_language_search: Search, or type a code such as ar-EG
models_list_fallback: This list is a fallback kept in code, not the provider's own: the provider could not be asked (%1$s). Refresh once it can be.
models_list_fallback_short: Fallback list, not the provider's own
models_list_from_account: These are the models your %1$s plan offers, as the provider lists them for your account.
models_loopback: This address is loopback, and the hub runs in a container: it would reach the container itself, not your machine. Try %1$s.
models_model_search: Search, or type a model id
models_no_models: No models yet. Refresh the model list first.
models_scope_all_hint: Shared: every profile uses it, including profiles made later.
models_scope_profile_hint: Only %1$s uses it, and its key wins there over a shared provider of the same kind.
models_sign_in_approved: Signed in. Its models are being fetched.
models_sign_in_expired: The code ran out before it was used.
models_speech_models_none: The provider lists no models of this kind; type a model id in the search field.
models_test_failed: The provider answered with an error.
models_voices_documented: From the provider's documentation: it has no voice list to ask.
models_voices_none: This provider lists no voices: type the voice id in the search field.
